Khamoshi soch ko tez karti.
Grit lamba hai.
Grit challenges ko opportunities banata.
Grit keep going ki determination hai.
Shaant zindagi chhoti nahi hoti.
Khamoshi choice hai, khaali-pan nahi.
Kam bolo, zyada karo.
Saat baar giro, aathvi baar phir khade ho jao.
Himmat growth choose karti hai.
Sabar kamyabi ka pul hai.
Saat baar girna, aathvi baar khada hona.
Koi bhi hamesha wise nahi.
Main knees pe jeene se better—feet pe marna prefer karunga.
Fear utni hi gehri jitni mind allow kare.
Bahadur dil endure karte.
Thehraav hi spashtta ki chabi hai.
Gusse ka sabse behtareen jawab khamoshi hai.
Darpok baar baar marte hain.
Sahi shabd bhi kaam aata hai, lekin koi bhi shabd khamoshi ko nahi badal sakta.
Sahas sabhi gunon mein sabse zaroori hai, kyunki sahas ke bina koi bhi gun lagatar nahi chal sakta.
